questions.q: What is a business function, in the business unit context?
options: A specific business process, such as Payables Invoicing or Requisitioning, that a business unit is enabled to carry out
A type of chart of accounts segment
The currency a business unit is required to use
A mathematical formula used in reporting
questions.explain: Business functions are specific processes, like Payables Invoicing, Billing and Revenue Management, or Requisitioning, assigned to a business unit.

questions.q: Can a single business unit be assigned more than one business function?
options: No, each business unit may perform exactly one function
Yes — a business unit can be configured to handle multiple functions, such as both Payables Invoicing and Requisitioning
Only if it has two separate ledgers
Only secondary business units can have multiple functions
questions.explain: A business unit is not limited to one function; a company may combine several functions into one business unit depending on how operations are organized.

questions.q: In the shared service provider pattern, what role does the 'service provider' business unit play?
options: It only ever handles its own legal entity's transactions
It replaces the need for a primary ledger
It performs a function on behalf of other, client business units
It is excluded from all business functions
questions.explain: A service provider business unit performs a specific function, such as Payables Invoicing, for one or more other business units designated as its clients.

questions.q: What is a real-world example this lesson gives of the shared service model?
options: A business unit with no assigned functions at all
A legal entity being split into two ledgers
Every division independently staffing its own full accounts payable team
A company centralizing Payables Invoicing into one shared-services business unit that processes invoices for several operating business units
questions.explain: Centralizing Payables Invoicing into one shared-services business unit serving multiple operating divisions mirrors how many real finance organizations are structured.

questions.q: Why does business function assignment matter beyond being descriptive metadata?
options: It has no real effect on the system
It directly determines which setup tasks and reference data options appear for that business unit
It only affects the color of the business unit's icon
It is only relevant to legal entity registration
questions.explain: A business unit without a given function assigned will not show that function's setup tasks or reference data options at all — assigning the function unlocks that configuration surface.
